name: Upload a map into a season
description: Admin only, and THE ONLY WAY A SEASON MAP REACHES THE PLATFORM: season maps are in no repository and no release. The body is one map file, exactly as mapgen writes it. It is stored DISABLED -- an upload changes nothing about pairing until an admin enables it -- and it is public from this moment. Checked in the order a mistake is most likely: the season exists and is not closed; the header is a header; it fits the cartridge's limits.boards, which is the envelope admission's reference set was drawn on, so a model admitted today can play it; the season plays the engine this node loaded, because validating a board on another engine proves nothing; it is not a board the season already has, by id or by content; and THE ENGINE ACCEPTS IT -- tb.ants.worldgen, run here on the board as sent, which is the validator every match would run anyway. Its refusal reaches a workflow as a code and never as the engine's reason, so the 422 points at `tinybrains maps check`, which runs the same engine locally and prints why. Its rate is per_admin_board_rate, not the 1 rps every other write gets: a season's boards arrive together, thirty-odd uploads and as many enables, from one admin.

with.name: Admins only
with.description: The role is read off the live session rather than off a claim in the cookie, so revoking a session or demoting a user takes effect on the next request.

tasks.name: Everything the upload is checked against

body.detail: A closed season's boards are its record; nothing is added to them.
A map file names its `id` (lower-case letters, digits and hyphens) and whole-number `players`, `rows` and `cols`.

with.name: Inside the envelope
with.description: limits.boards is what the basic boards span -- seats, each side, cells -- and so what admission proved every adapter against. A board outside it could strike an admitted model on every turn.

with.name: The season's engine, on this node
Not a board it already has
with.description: A board is never uploaded twice: one taken out of play is disabled, and enabling it again is the fix, which the detail makes possible by saying whether it is.

body.detail: The engine refused this board. `tinybrains maps check <file>` runs the same engine and prints its reason.
Another upload of this board, or the season's close, got there first. Read the season's maps and try again.

input.query: SELECT season_map_json(sm) AS body FROM season_maps sm JOIN seasons se ON se.id = sm.season_id JOIN games g ON g.id = se.game_id WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text AND se.slug = ($2)::text AND sm.map_id = (season_map_header(($3)::jsonb) ->> 'id')
